answer: Sybil resistance comes from registering each agent key only after remote attestation verifies its enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and binds the key to a genuine SGX platform. MRENCLAVE identifies enclave code, not a unique chip, so enforcement must also check platform credentials and limit issuance. Cloning walnut, sparrow, or glacier in ordinary virtual machines cannot forge those proofs; creating another eligible identity requires access to additional trusted silicon.
